propositions: Fourteen call sites in src/rebar/llm hand-build identical single-turn structured request shapes with copy-paste pattern, violating DRY and hiding bounding decisions.
RunRequest's contract requires single_turn requests to carry mode='structured' and output_schema, but no enforcement mechanism exists; the constraint is re-asserted by hand at each site.

Only one of fourteen sites (judge_batch) declares lowering-only seams (output_token_limit, structured_retry_limit, transport_attempt_limit, request_timeout_limit_s), making omission silent and indistinguishable from deliberate unbounding.
A shared builder method RunRequest.for_structured with required SingleTurnBounds argument will enforce the contract and make bounding decisions explicit and greppable.
AST guard test must be extended to recognize RunRequest.for_structured calls in addition to direct RunRequest(...) calls to prevent FAIL OPEN when fourteen sites adopt the builder.
